claim_decisions.text: Inspire3 publishes brands including Zen12 and Hypnosis Live.
claim_decisions.caveat: No proof of FV publisher eligibility.

claim_decisions.text: Zen12 Premium public listing says 12 levels spanning 12 months.
claim_decisions.caveat: Not subscription term or payments evidence.

claim_decisions.text: Zen12 Premium public listing says 48 MP3s.
claim_decisions.caveat: No purchase/download verification.

claim_decisions.text: Zen12 lists a user manual, quick start, level guides, call, and support.
claim_decisions.caveat: Support service levels/device compatibility unverified.

claim_decisions.text: Zen12 public Premium offer showed $87.99 on Nov 6 2026.
claim_decisions.caveat: Other promotions can differ; no verified final checkout/tax/discount.

claim_decisions.text: Seller advertises a one-year money-back guarantee.
claim_decisions.caveat: Refund implementation, consumer eligibility and exact terms unverified.

claim_decisions.text: Seller states 12 min equals 1h advanced meditation.
claim_decisions.caveat: No product-specific comparable-outcome proof verified.

claim_decisions.text: Seller says brainwave technology automatically meditates for buyer.
claim_decisions.caveat: Consumer mental efficacy assertion without independent product trial.

claim_decisions.text: Seller promises improved health and brain function.
claim_decisions.caveat: Clinical and objective health outcome substantiation absent for product.

claim_decisions.text: 24 highly suggestible participants had faster and more confident word recognition after a posthypnotic cue.
claim_decisions.caveat: Small selected sample, laboratory word task, not consumer MP3.

claim_decisions.text: The posthypnotic cue improved recognition accuracy in the trial.
claim_decisions.caveat: Accuracy AUC ~0.961 vs 0.956, nonsignificant difference.

claim_decisions.text: The posthypnotic cue result persisted at one-week retest.
claim_decisions.caveat: Do not extrapolate long-term life outcomes.

claim_decisions.text: A 49-patient acquired-brain-injury hypnosis RCT validates Zen12 Premium.
claim_decisions.caveat: Different intervention/population and subjective outcome caveats.

claim_decisions.text: A 91-participant scene-change confidence study demonstrates product efficacy.
claim_decisions.caveat: No commercial product or meditation tested.

claim_decisions.text: Change blindness without interruption in a 2000 study includes gradual changes.
claim_decisions.caveat: Do not generalize to abrupt unoccluded changes.

claim_decisions.text: Nine months of attention-only training improved all cognitive skills.
claim_decisions.caveat: Multiple distinct modules; working-memory improvement specific to attention module, measured null outcomes.

claim_decisions.text: Inspire3 public affiliate program proves FV is accepted.
claim_decisions.caveat: Named authorization must be verified from authenticated publisher account.

claim_decisions.text: Public advertised 60%+ commissions apply to FV.
claim_decisions.caveat: No individual account rates/terms; do not promote payout claims.

claim_decisions.text: FV may email or advertise affiliate links on Grok's channels.
claim_decisions.caveat: Require per-channel written permission and platform policies.

claim_decisions.text: A public seller URL is safe to activate before approval.
claim_decisions.caveat: Commercial route must remain disabled without verified terms.

claim_decisions.text: A near-link possible-commission disclosure is appropriate on a commercial recommendation.
claim_decisions.caveat: If linked, use proximate plain English, and verify real relationship status.

claim_decisions.text: Existing Focus Fieldbook and Jetpack path can be referenced.
claim_decisions.caveat: No new form or subscriber count claim; guest delivery still not retested.

claim_decisions.text: Puységur's historical notes demonstrate modern hypnosis efficacy.
claim_decisions.caveat: Historical record vs clinical evidence.

claim_decisions.text: Outbound click equals affiliate sale or FV revenue.
claim_decisions.caveat: Only independently reported and paid FV commissions are affiliate revenue.

claim_decisions.text: A qualified-human session or product purchase has been independently measured today.
claim_decisions.caveat: Do not substitute bot-heavy Jetpack views or merchant gross for FV net.

claim_decisions.text: An actively sellable rights-cleared FV Payhip Mind SKU exists.
claim_decisions.caveat: Requires authenticated SKU, rights, final checkout, digital delivery and refund proof.
